Pakistan Court Orders Imran Khan's Transfer to Hospital from Jail

Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered the transfer of former Prime Minister Imran Khan from jail to a hospital for medical examination. The court directed that Khan be moved to Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad within days. Concerns about Khan's health, including his vision and blood pressure, have been raised by his family and former President Arif Alvi. His lawyers had previously stated he lost significant vision in his right eye while in prison.
